mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (user_id, target_type, target_id, content, comment_time, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{content}, NOW(), 1)
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.username, u.avatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.target_id = #{targetId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.comment_time DESC
SELECT c.*, u.username FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY c.comment_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status = 0 WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE comment SET status = #{status} WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
